steps.message:
The issue was that when a route function is annotated with `-> "None"`, `get_typed_return_annotation` returned `NoneType` instead of `None`. This caused an assertion error in `fastapi/routing.py` when the status code was `204 No Content`, as `NoneType` is truthy and thus interpreted as a response model that requires a body.

I modified `get_typed_annotation` in `fastapi/dependencies/utils.py` to return `None` if the evaluated annotation is `NoneType`. This ensures that `-> "None"`, `-> None`, and `-> type(None)` are all treated consistently as `None`, allowing `204 No Content` responses to be used without triggering the response body assertion.
